latin: Qui finalem causam diluuiorum incendiorumque cognouerit, haec potius «kaθάρσεις», id est purgationes, quam corruptiones uocabit.
translation: One who grasps the final cause behind floods and fires will name them purifications — 'katharseis' — rather than acts of destruction.
